messages:
alan: quick idea 1min2 17302 - use a shadow-proxy ping + lease-heartbeat crosscheck to detect inter-region lease loss without active customer traffic probes. cheaper and safer for consented tenants.

priya: sounds promising. how does shadow-proxy differ from the eviction canary approach?

alan: canary injects synthetic load. shadow-proxy sends a lightweight signed heartbeat to the current lease holder and expects a signed ack. if ack missing and KV ownership shows recent handoff, mark as possible lease-loss. no customer tokens sent across regions.

josh: what signals do we rely on? lease-epoch, last-ack-latency, owner-host-id, and routing-table version?

alan: yup. minimal signals: 1) lease_epoch, 2) owner_node_id, 3) last_heartbeat_ts, 4) recent_lease_transitions (30s window), 5) routing_observed_region for real requests. combine into lease_confidence_score.

elaine: billing/legal: since no customer payload crosses boundaries, should be fine for consented tenants. still need to ensure metadata we store about owners is PII-free.

priya: ops question 17302 - if a lease_confidence_score falls below threshold, what's the next step? auto-failover or alert?

josh: prefer staged response: 1) soft-alert (debug) + create gold-log of heartbeat traces, 2) promote read-only routing away from suspect owner, 3) page if score stays low for 60s. full auto-failover only after manual ack or postmortem tuning.

alan: agree. also propose a transient shadow-read routing mode: route small % of reads to alternate region to validate read correctness before any write traffic moves.

elaine: can we get a sample header for the heartbeat so logging and billing can filter them?

alan: sample below (for logs only, not forwarded to model infra):

```json
{
  "x-rw-probe": "lease-heartbeat-v1",
  "probe-id": "hb-2026-03-21-01",
  "origin-node": "edge-12-us-west",
  "target-owner": "tenant-lease-node-43",
  "timestamp_utc": "2026-03-21T01:12:34Z"
}
```

priya: make sure probe id and timestamps are normalized in ingestion. also tag whether the probe was internal-only so billing ignores it.

josh: telemetry idea 17302 - derive owner_staleness_ms = now - last_owner_heartbeat. use EWMA over 3s windows to dampen noisy networks.

elaine: privacy check: we should hash node ids when surfacing to product dashboards. raw node ids only in gold-logs for SRE.

alan: operator playbook (draft):

- step 0: auto-detect lease_confidence_score < 0.5 -> create incident with severity P2 (info)
- step 1: run shadow-read validation to confirm data served matches canonical store (checksum)
- step 2: if mismatch or no ack after 60s -> page oncall, attach last 5 heartbeat traces and lease-transition history
- step 3: operator may trigger controlled lease-revoke handshake to leader candidate; that handshake must require >1 human ack if tenant flagged legal-sensitive

priya: add a cost-estimate line in playbook so support/product can judge customer impact before paging.

josh: implementation notes: lightweight agent on each region will do heartbeat fanout to lease owners. must be rate-limited and randomized to avoid synchronized storms. record probe success/failure counters per-tenant.

elaine: can we do a non-probing passive fallback for consented tenants? e.g., if model-call origin != serve-region and refill_latency spikes, mark suspected and surface to product only. no probes.

alan: yes, passive heuristics will be labeled lower confidence. flag = "suspected_lease_loss_passive". do not auto-page on passive alone.

alert-bot: suggestion: rollout plan - feature-flag + shadow mode for 1 week in canary region, collect metrics, then enable operator alerts. created ticket RN-4902.

priya: regression/backfill ask: please pull last 90 days of lease transitions and compare with incidents to calibrate thresholds. annotate false-positives so ML classifier (later) can improve recall/precision.

josh: timeline: i'll prototype the agent and heartbeat protocol this sprint. alan will spec playbook and console bits. elaine will start legal review on node-id retention policy.

alan: thanks. i'll post a short RFC PR with protocol sketch and playbook tonight. ping here for review.

elaine: +1. tagging compliance to review the plan when RFC PR is posted.
